pictures.name: first_sun_on_a_hilltop
pictures.scene: a bare rounded hilltop taking the very first sun of the day, the near grass and stone lit warm and gold along the bottom of the frame, the country below and the sky above it still blue and quiet

pictures.name: great_summit_in_clear_air
pictures.scene: an enormous mountain summit standing sharp and clear in cold high air, the near ridge lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the great pale peak and the sky around it vast and open and calm

pictures.name: daily_lamp_lit_again
pictures.scene: one clay lamp freshly filled and newly lit on a worn stone shelf, its flame and the shelf lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the wall above it plain and brown and deep in even shadow

pictures.name: unmeasured_canyon
pictures.scene: an immense canyon opening away in ridge behind ridge with no end in sight, the nearest rim lit warm and hard along the bottom of the frame, the far walls above it going blue and soft and endless

pictures.name: worn_steps_of_many_generations
pictures.scene: a long flight of stone steps hollowed deep in the middle by centuries of use, the lowest treads lit warm and low, the stair above them climbing quietly away into a soft and even upper shade

pictures.name: light_breaking_through_high_cloud
pictures.scene: broad shafts of sunlight breaking down through a bank of high cloud onto open country, the near fields lit warm and gold, the great sky above them bright and deep and full of slow moving light

pictures.name: waterfall_over_a_cliff
pictures.scene: a heavy waterfall pouring white over a cliff into a deep pool, the churned water lit bright and warm at the bottom of the frame, the sheer wet rock above it dark and towering and full of mist

pictures.name: orchard_heavy_with_fruit
pictures.scene: an orchard of low trees bent under ripe fruit in late afternoon, the nearest branches lit warm and full along the bottom of the frame, the rows beyond them going soft and green and quiet in the shade

pictures.name: slow_deep_river
pictures.scene: a broad deep river moving so slowly that its surface lies almost flat, the near water lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the far bank and the sky above it soft and green and unhurried

pictures.name: rain_falling_over_a_wide_country
pictures.scene: steady rain falling in soft grey curtains across a wide green country, the nearest grass lit warm and wet at the bottom of the frame, the hills and cloud above them dim and even and full of water

pictures.name: meadow_full_of_flowers_open
pictures.scene: a wide meadow with every flower in it standing fully open to the sun, the nearest blooms lit warm and bright along the bottom of the frame, the field beyond them running away soft and pale and calm

pictures.name: far_walls_bright_across_the_valley
pictures.scene: the walls of a city catching full sun on the far side of a wide valley, the near slope lit warm and low, the bright ramparts and the sky above them clear and pale and standing high and quiet

pictures.name: broad_stair_climbing_to_the_light
pictures.scene: a broad ceremonial stair of pale stone climbing straight up toward an open bright sky, the lowest steps lit warm and clear, the long rise above them going pale and soft and free of any detail

pictures.name: enduring_stone_foundations
pictures.scene: enormous foundation blocks of dressed stone set close and level and still perfectly true, the nearest course lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the wall above them rising dim and plain

lines.text: A Psalm of praise. Of David.
I will exalt You, my God and King;
I will bless Your name forever and ever.
Every day I will bless You,
and I will praise Your name forever and ever.
Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised;
His greatness is unsearchable.
One generation will commend Your works to the next,
and will proclaim Your mighty acts—
the glorious splendor of Your majesty.
And I will meditate on Your wondrous works.
They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds,
and I will declare Your greatness.
They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness
and sing joyfully of Your righteousness.
The LORD is gracious and compassionate,
slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.
The LORD is good to all;
His compassion rests on all He has made.
All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD,
and Your saints will bless You.
They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom
and speak of Your might,
to make known to men Your mighty acts
and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom.
Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom,
and Your dominion endures through all generations.
